header.openPresenterViewHint: Notes, next slide, participants and the phone remote

load.forbidden: You are not authorized to host this deck.

template.title: This is a template
template.body: “{title}” is a template, so it is not presented. Use it to make a deck, then present that deck.
template.failed: Couldn't create a deck from this template.

ready.title: Ready to present
ready.hint: Start presenting right away, or open the lobby first so people can join with the code before you begin.

lobby.scanOrJoin: Scan the QR code, or go to
lobby.waiting: Waiting for players to enter code...

slide.untimed: No time limit — close voting when you're ready.

endDialog.title: End this session?
endDialog.body: Answers stop and everyone who joined sees the final screen. The results stay in the session report.

errors.alreadyLive: A session is already live for this deck. Showing it now.
errors.noLiveSession: There is no live session any more. Start presenting to begin a new one.
errors.busy: Another change was in progress. Try again.
errors.noTimer: This slide has no running timer.
errors.remote: Could not pair the phone remote.

console.notesHint: Only you see these. They never reach the audience.
console.audienceHint: Drag it to the projector and press F there for fullscreen.
console.audienceBlocked: The browser blocked the window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
console.soundLabel: Sound cues for start, reveal and the timer

kickDialog.title: Remove {name}?
kickDialog.body: They leave the session at once, their phone shows that they were removed, and they cannot answer or join this session again. Answers they already gave stay in the results.

remote.title: Phone remote
remote.hint: Scan with your phone to change slides, reveal results and control the timer from anywhere in the room.
remote.statusWaiting: Waiting for a phone to scan
remote.oneDevice: The first phone to open the link is the only one that can use it.
remote.codeHidden: The pairing code is shown once. Make a new one to pair another phone.

audience.waitingHint: Open this window from the presenter view with “Open audience window”.
audience.presenterClosed: The presenter view was closed. This window shows the last slide until it comes back.
